lead_raw_text:
The structure of MgFe6(OF)2 crystallizes in the cubic space group F-43m (No. 216), with a 40-atom unit cell and five independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Fe centers adopting octahedral coordination, with two distinct octahedral environments: one with two F and four O neighbors and another with four F and two O neighbors, while Mg centers are tetrahedrally coordinated by two F and two O neighbors. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner-sharing between Fe octahedra, edge-sharing between Fe octahedra and Mg tetrahedra, and edge-sharing among Mg tetrahedra.
